text:
Stradal Group acquired Fennimore Optics in a deal announced Monday, taking full ownership of the lensmaker for an undisclosed sum. The purchase adds Fennimore’s 2024 revenue of 48 million crowns and its 310-employee plant in Caldor Bay to Stradal’s industrial portfolio.

Stradal said the company will keep Fennimore’s brand and fold its optical components into its precision tools division. Chief executive Mara Velin said the deal should lift group margins by 1.2 points within 18 months through shared procurement and logistics.

For the sector, the transaction underscores continued consolidation in specialty optics, where scale is becoming critical as input costs rise and smaller suppliers struggle to finance automation.
